Hero.title: We engineer the software your idea deserves.
Hero.subtitle: Shamflare plans, designs and builds websites, mobile apps and desktop applications — then stays with you to keep them fast, secure and up to date.
Hero.visualLabel: Illustration: one codebase delivered to web, mobile and desktop interfaces

Home.introTitle: An engineering-first partner for digital products.
Home.introBody: We work with businesses, startups and individual founders who need software that is built properly. That means clear requirements, careful architecture, honest timelines and code that someone can maintain after launch.
Home.introPoint1Body: We define scope, priorities and risks with you before development starts.
Home.introPoint2Body: Readable code, documentation and automated checks — not just a working demo.
Home.introPoint3Body: Updates, fixes and improvements continue once your product is live.
Home.servicesBody: From a first website to a cross-platform application, each engagement is scoped to what your users actually need.
Home.portfolioBody: A look at how we structure, design and engineer software products.
Home.processTitle: A transparent process from idea to launch.
Home.processStep1Body: We learn your goals, users and constraints, then agree on scope and priorities.
Home.processStep2Body: Information architecture, interface design and a technical plan you can review.
Home.processStep3Body: Iterative development with regular demos, code review and automated testing.
Home.processStep4Body: Deployment, monitoring and ongoing maintenance as your product grows.
Home.capability1Body: Fast, accessible, search-friendly websites and web applications.
Home.capability2Body: iOS and Android applications with a consistent, native-feeling experience.
Home.capability3Body: Reliable tools for Windows, macOS and Linux, including offline workflows.
Home.capability4Body: Well-documented APIs and connections to the services you already use.
Home.capability5Body: Containerized deployments, backups and environments you control.
Home.capability6Body: Testing, secure defaults and careful handling of your users’ data.
Home.ctaTitle: Have an idea for a product?
Home.ctaBody: Tell us what you want to build. We will review it and reply with questions, a suggested approach and the next steps.

About.title: Software built with care, explained with honesty.
About.intro: Shamflare is a software development company focused on turning ideas into useful digital products.
About.principle1Body: Decisions are based on your requirements, measurable trade-offs and proven technology — not trends.
About.principle2Body: Code review, automated tests, accessibility checks and documentation are part of every delivery.
About.principle3Body: You see progress regularly, understand what is being built and why, and own your code and data.
About.principle4Body: Secure configuration, careful data handling and maintained dependencies from the first commit.
About.ctaBody: Describe what you have in mind — we will help you shape it into a plan.

Contact.title: Tell us about your project.
Contact.intro: Share as much as you know today. We read every inquiry and reply with questions, a suggested approach and the next steps.
Contact.directBody: Message us on WhatsApp or email us — whichever is easier for you.
